def int_to_mini_roman(number)
  mapping = [
    [1000, "m"], [900, "cm"], [500, "d"], [400, "cd"],
    [100, "c"], [90, "xc"], [50, "l"], [40, "xl"],

  return nil if arr.empty?
  sum_magnitudes = arr.map(&:abs).sum
  if arr.any?(&:zero?)

  else

  end
end
